items.title: Commencement
notes: A meeting of City Council was held at 1:30 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic, with all members present except Councillors D. Schnider, M. Johnston and P. Singh. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Donation to the City of Kitchener, DSD-2025-398, DSD-2025-398

items.title: Media Announcement
notes: The Mayor and Members of Council acknowledged Maureen Cowan and members of the Cowan family will be present, along with Mary D’Alton, Executive Director of the Cowan Foundation, for the generous donation to the City in the amount of $2.5 Million, which the City will acknowledge through the naming of the City’s newest Indoor Recreation Complex and Indoor Turf Fieldhouse as the Cowan Recreation Centre and Cowan Fieldhouse located at 1955 Fischer-Hallman Road, Kitchener (currently under construction).

items.title: Recess and Reconvene
notes: The Special Council meeting then recessed at 2:08 p.m. and reconvened at 3:30 p.m., chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic, with all members present except Councillors D. Schnider, M. Johnston and P. Singh.

items.title: Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 3:30 p.m.

motions.item_title: Donation to the City of Kitchener, DSD-2025-398, DSD-2025-398
motions.text: "That the Mayor and Clerk be authorized to execute a Donation Agreement with The Cowan Foundation, recognizing a donation in the amount of $2.5 Million, which will be acknowledged through the naming of the City’s newest Indoor Recreation Complex and Indoor Turf Fieldhouse as the Cowan Recreation Centre and Cowan Fieldhouse, located at 1955 Fischer-Hallman Road, Kitchener (currently under construction), in accordance with the discussion at the August 11, 2025 in-camera meeting of Council; said agreement to be to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor."
motions.text_html: "That the Mayor and Clerk be authorized to execute a Donation Agreement with The Cowan Foundation, recognizing a donation in the amount of $2.5 Million, which will be acknowledged through the naming of the City’s newest Indoor Recreation Complex and Indoor Turf Fieldhouse as the Cowan Recreation Centre and Cowan Fieldhouse, located at 1955 Fischer-Hallman Road, Kitchener (currently under construction), in accordance with the discussion at the August 11, 2025 in-camera meeting of Council; said agreement to be to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor."

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider three matters, specifically a solicitor client privilege matter; a solicitor client privilege & potential litigation matter; and, a potential land disposition matter as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (c) (e) and (f) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."
